research_question: Before comparing another perception model with the current YOLO system, does the evaluation chain distinguish source-grounded scene evidence from user-event facts, and does a strictly richer oracle input produce no worse frozen event outcomes?
purpose: Audit the evaluator, not train, tune, select or promote a model.
claim_ceiling: No model-quality, generalization, assistive-safety, product, Android or default-App claim
A passed oracle ladder only establishes that this frozen evaluation route can be used for later candidate comparison; it does not establish that a candidate is beneficial

predecessor_boundary.interpretation: The prior 30-event cohort is evidence of a possible evaluator/actionability mismatch, but is consumed and cannot be rerun, relabeled, threshold-tuned, or used as this audit's cohort.

required_event_properties: continuous native-source RGB and mask window
four frozen causal P0 action-review anchors
positive events include a pre-alert/no-reminder anchor, at least one reminder-now anchor, and at least one passed-clear anchor; P1 must turn these into full-event intervals
negative events contain the complete no-reminder observation window
disjointness: native source session must be absent from the generated exclusion registry
camera, lens, crop, frame, adjacent window and parent-event aliases do not create independence
a post-freeze full-data contamination audit must find no exact RGB, decoded RGB, source-session, ancestry or parent-event overlap; unresolved pHash candidates are HOLD, not clean

scene_fact_layer.unit: frame within parent event; parent event/source session remains the independent unit
allowed_facts: native mask source hash and RGB source hash
semantic class area and connected components
deterministically derived truth boxes from source components
mask-to-box coverage, false area, unmatched component and temporal overlap measures
forbidden_interpretation: source mask is not a user-action or safety truth
scene coverage is not an alert, clearance or model-promotion result
frame count is not an independent statistical denominator

event_fact_layer.unit: P0 uses four fixed causal RGB anchors per parent event, each delivered as a distinct opaque review item in independently shuffled order; only a passing P0 authorizes P1 full-event factual intervals and parent-event sequence

review_conditions.ACTION_REVIEW_A: fresh isolated reviewer; current RGB plus only prior RGB context ending at anchor
review_conditions.ACTION_REVIEW_B: fresh isolated reviewer; independent opaque ordering and no access to review A

reviewer_forbidden_fields: source session and parent event identity
YOLO, PIDNet, oracle, score, trace or previous review output
event_fact_layer.unresolved_policy: Raw abstention or disagreement becomes UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUABLE. It must never become NO reminder, cleared or safe. No third-review adjudication, prompt repair or post-hoc consensus is permitted.
event_fact_layer.p0_anchor_screen: Both isolated P0 action reviews must be submitted and scored before any P1 full-event review packet, YOLO, box, mask or synthetic-oracle feedback trace is materialized.
event_fact_layer.p1_full_event_facts: After P0 passes, two new isolated full-event causal RGB reviews freeze each positive alertable interval and passed-clear interval. The ledger binds both review SHA-256 values, records zero unresolved units, and is required before any full-frame trace is materialized.
event_fact_layer.before_trace_access: P0 consistency and P1 full-event facts are both required before any YOLO, box, mask or synthetic-oracle feedback trace is materialized.

scene_fact_adapter.authorization: Runs only after passed P0 and P1 receipts, and reads only admitted native source masks; it never reads a model, oracle or feedback trace.
scene_fact_adapter.canonical_truth: truth mask is the binary union of the fixed boundary and obstacle source IDs; truth boxes are deterministic source (class_id, instance_id) components, not actionability labels.

frozen_bucket_rule.blocking_obstacle_positive: pre-output center_obstacle source-mask stratum plus a P1 reminder interval
frozen_bucket_rule.boundary_level_change_positive: pre-output step_curb source-mask stratum plus a P1 reminder interval
frozen_bucket_rule.parallel_curb_negative: pre-output step_curb source-mask stratum plus no P1 reminder interval
frozen_bucket_rule.normal_walkable_negative: pre-output strict_normal_walkable source-mask stratum plus no P1 reminder interval
frozen_bucket_rule.integrity_gate: All 48 frozen screening events must map without substitution to exactly 12 parent events in each bucket; otherwise HOLD_EVAL_VALIDITY_DATA.

arms.current_yolo: Current frozen yolo11n baseline output only.
arms.truth_box: Source-fact components transformed deterministically to canonical truth boxes.
arms.truth_mask: Source-fact native semantic masks transformed deterministically to canonical truth masks.
arms.synthetic_oracle: Host-only event-fact directive: fires exactly on agreed reminder-now anchors and is clear on agreed cleared anchors. It is an evaluator-integrity control, never a runtime feature or model target.

shared_execution.clock: frozen source-frame timestamp at review anchor
shared_execution.reset: one reset at each parent-event start for every arm
shared_execution.rule: All arms use the same frozen downstream clock, decision configuration and feedback accounting. Only their declared evidence input differs.

event_quality: premature alert events before the P1 alertable interval
first response delay on the frozen causal anchors
two_layer_report.interpretation: Representation quality may rank research hypotheses only after the evaluator passes. Event quality decides only whether a later candidate can advance; neither layer alone authorizes a default-App change.

oracle_ladder: truth_box must be no worse than current_yolo
truth_mask must be no worse than truth_box
synthetic_oracle must be no worse than truth_mask

No-worse means no fewer positive hits, no more critical misses, no more premature-alert events, no more negative false-alert events, no fewer cleared positives, no later shared positive response, and no bucket-level regression.
synthetic_oracle must hit and clear every evaluable positive and alert on no negative.

forbidden: reusing, re-scoring, relabeling or tuning the consumed 30-event cohort
model training, checkpoint selection, threshold selection or seed selection
changing the event cohort after output access
modifying adapter, risk, temporal, event or feedback rules after trace access
using synthetic-oracle behavior as a model target or runtime feature
